title: Concept: Datadog client token in a response
description: A Datadog browser SDK client token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A client token is not a full API key, but it lets anyone send events and RUM data into the account, which pollutes the telemetry the bank uses for incident detection.
applicability: Deployments that render a Datadog browser SDK client token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A client token is not a full API key, but it lets anyone send events and RUM data into the account, which pollutes the telemetry the bank uses for incident detection.
